lines.para: This episode is freely adapted from Patrick Pesnot’s programme on France Inter, broadcast on 26 May 2012.
To Patrick Pesnot, who for twenty years took us to meet the men in the shadows.
And to Monsieur X, who never existed, and whom we all believed.
